tasks.CalculateRemainingBudget: Calculate the remaining budget after purchasing the maximum number of trousers.
tasks.CalculateTotalCost: Calculate the total cost of purchasing trousers and shirts given their prices.
tasks.DetermineMaxTrousers: Determine the maximum number of trousers that can be purchased with the given budget.
tasks.DetermineShirtsFromRemainingBudget: Determine how many shirts can be bought from the remaining budget.
tasks.FindRatio: Find the ratio of trousers to shirts based on the calculated numbers.
